text:
marta: Rolling v2.12.0-canary into pool-e at 04:32 UTC. Quick smoke: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth. @deploy-bot please run canary-small.

deploy-bot: started smoke-suite (canary-small). probes: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth. ETA ~2m.

li: Acceptance note: block if kv-prefill p95 > 95ms OR embed-synth p95 > 240ms OR sustained 5xx >0.5% for >60s.

sre-oncall: seeing kv-prefill p95 spike in pool-e to 138ms, prefix cache misses high. Raising INC-2026-888.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite results:
- kv-prefill: FAIL (p95=138ms, cache-miss spike)
- http-heartbeat: OK
- embed-synth: OK
Canary status: FAIL (kv-prefill).

ben: prefer targeted rollback for pool-e + pin to v2.11.5. Avoid global rollback since embed and heartbeat are fine. Also capture prefetch traces and kernel logs.

marta: Agreed. Execute targeted rollback + pin, then run post-rollback kv warmup and an extended prefill probe (5m) in pool-e. Add a temporary alert: kv-prefill p95 > 80ms over 2m.

# command
```
/deploy rollback inference --region pool-e --to-version v2.11.5 --reason "kv-prefill prefill regression"
/deploy pin inference --region pool-e --to-version v2.11.5 --reason "pin after prefill regression"
```

deploy-bot: Targeted rollback + pin initiated by marta at 04:35 UTC. Rolling back pool-e -> v2.11.5. ETA ~45s. Will auto-run post-rollback kv-prefill extended probe.

sre-oncall: INC-2026-888 created: kv-prefill-pool-e. Collecting prefix-cache metrics, prefetch traces, and host kernel logs.

deploy-bot: Post-rollback kv-prefill: p95=36ms, cache-hit=99%. pool-e status: PASS. Canary overall: PASS (pool-e pinned to v2.11.5).

li: Nice containment. Follow-ups: 1) repro with v2.12.0 prefetch config, 2) run extended canary with traffic ramp paused, 3) add short blurb in release notes: "Targeted rollback in pool-e for kv-prefill prefetch regression; pinned and investigating." :white_check_mark:
